findings.body: The revised provider translation still classifies against every permitted domain instead of the provider's selected domain. For example, when a governed-financial selection rejects cross-domain operand `mis-statement.percentage`, this lookup finds that permitted percent measure and reports `NotComparable`; `normalizeMeasureFilters` against governed-financial correctly reports `UnknownMeasure` because the operand is outside that domain. Thus provider-door refusals and structured logs still disagree with the canonical helper. The added cross-domain test covers only the money-formatted `mis-statement.actual_net`, so it misses this case.
findings.title: Not done: A comparison that cannot be honoured is refused with a stated reason, never silently dropped

findings.body: The empty-answer test still injects an empty table through `FakeExecutor`, so it does not prove that real filtered SQL execution reaches the API as a successful zero-row answer with the stated message. The story assigns that warehouse/API/browser proof (functional matrix row 6) to MEASURE-FILTER-SURFACES, making this a later-task test gap rather than a blocker for this branch.
findings.title: Later: prove the empty Ask answer through MEASURE-FILTER-SURFACES
